parsed.rationale: To initiate outreach to global brand CSR departments effectively, we must first address the major informational constraint regarding target fund budgets and alignment criteria. Our strategy begins with an intensive external research phase to map and identify CSR alignments. We will then design tailored pitch materials that leverage Mia's incredibly strong academic and athletic narrative to present a compelling philanthropic opportunity for co-funding the Yuwa Academy. Finally, we establish a gated sequence of outreach steps to execute the strategy safely.
